def lrmc(MM, omega, opts):
    tol = opts.get('tol', 1e-8)
    max_iter = opts.get('max_iter', 500)
    mu = opts.get('mu', 1e-4)
    max_mu = opts.get('max_mu', 1e10)
    DEBUG = opts.get('DEBUG', 0)
    rho_update_factor = opts.get('rho_update_factor', 1.1)
    rho_tol = opts.get('rho_tol', 1e-4)

    d, n = MM.shape
    M = np.zeros((d, n))
    M[omega] = MM[omega]
    X = np.zeros((d, n))
    E = np.zeros((d, n))
    Y = np.zeros((d, n))
    rho = mu

    for iter in range(max_iter):
        Xk = X.copy()
        Ek = E.copy()

        # Update X
        X, nuclearnormX = prox_nuclear(-(E - M + Y / rho), 1 / rho)

        # Update E
        E = -(X - M + Y / rho)
        E[omega] = 0

        dY = X + E - M
        chgX = np.max(np.abs(Xk - X))
        chgE = np.max(np.abs(Ek - E))
        chg = np.max([chgX, chgE, np.max(np.abs(dY))])

        if DEBUG and (iter == 1 or iter % 10 == 0):
            obj = nuclearnormX
            err = np.linalg.norm(dY, 'fro')
            print(f'iter {iter + 1}, mu={mu}, rho={rho}, obj={obj}, err={err}')

        if chg < tol:
            break

        Y += rho * dY
        mu = min(rho_update_factor * mu, max_mu)
        rho = max(rho_update_factor * rho, mu)

        if np.abs(rho - mu) < rho_tol:
            rho = mu

    obj = nuclearnormX
    err = np.linalg.norm(dY, 'fro')
    return X, obj, err, iter
